last_summary: The strongest current interpretation is that Option C, 'detach the cabin and the chassis', is the action incorrectly performed in exactly two videos. v3 evidence directly shows tool manipulation at the yellow cabin/chassis interface, while v2 evidence involves the white cabin/body and chassis assembly context, supporting a two-video cabin-chassis detachment issue. Residual uncertainty remains because v3 does not definitively show full physical separation and v2's cabin-removal evidence is not fully represented in the answer evidence map, but no additional local probe is clearly likely to overturn this best-supported option.
review_reason: New evidence from v3 (indices 31, 36) clarifies that tool manipulation occurs near the cabin-chassis interface but does not definitively show physical separation or attachment failure for Option C. The ambiguity remains whether this action is 'incorrectly performed' as a detach or simply an adjustment/attachment, leaving R03 supported only tentatively based on the presence of the action rather than its correctness status relative to other videos.
